# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 at the start of the volume, turning 16 by its end  <sub>[v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v1 c38 P27](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0027)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P63](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0063)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Avonlea School (formerly student at Queen's Academy)  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Titles:** B.A. (aspirational / imaginary)  <sub>[v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027)</sub>; First Class Teacher  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>; Avery Scholarship Winner  <sub>[v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P15](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0015)</sub>; Anne of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c8 P56](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0056)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with a pale, freckled, pointed face, large expressive eyes that vary between green and gray, and a broad forehead. Her most distinctive feature is her thick hair, which is famously red—a lifelong source of grief to her—though it darkens to a rich auburn as she matures. At one point, her hair is accidentally dyed a bronze-green and must be shaved short.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015)_

## Personality

Anne is an intensely imaginative, emotional, and talkative girl who views the world with romantic wonder and deep passion. She possesses a dramatic flair, often using grand language to express her feelings, and alternates between ecstatic joys and the 'depths of despair.' Though fiercely quick-tempered when her looks—especially her hair—are criticized, she is deeply affectionate, loyal, and quick to repent when she realizes she has done wrong. Highly ambitious and hardworking, she matures into a thoughtful, bright, and determined young woman.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P29](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0029), [v1 c3 P33](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0033), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c31 P20](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0020)_

- To find kindred spirits and a true 'bosom friend'  <sub>[v1 c8 P36](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0036)</sub>
- To excel academically and prove herself in her studies  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P17](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0017)</sub>

## History

Anne Shirley arrives at Bright River station expecting to be adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, only to discover they had requested a boy to help on their farm. Though Marilla initially intends to send her back, Matthew is charmed by Anne's vivid chatter, and Marilla ultimately decides to keep her at Green Gables. Anne quickly settles into Avonlea, forming a passionate 'bosom friendship' with Diana Barry. Her early years are marked by dramatic misadventures: she flies into a rage at Mrs. Rachel Lynde for insulting her hair, mistakenly intoxicates Diana with currant wine, smashes a slate over Gilbert Blythe's head for calling her 'Carrots,' and breaks her ankle attempting a dare on a roof. Later, Anne saves Diana's baby sister from croup, earns the forgiveness of Diana's mother, and accidentally dyes her own hair green, necessitating a short haircut. At school, she enters a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe. She enters Queen's Academy, ties with Gilbert for first place on the entrance exams, wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship, and completes her First Class teacher's license in one year. Following the sudden death of Matthew Cuthbert from heart failure and Marilla's failing eyesight, Anne selflessly gives up her college scholarship to remain at Green Gables and teach at the Avonlea school. She finally forgives Gilbert Blythe, ending their long-standing feud to become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P54](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0054)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in poverty by Mrs. Thomas and later Mrs. Hammond, taking care of numerous children and twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Hopeton Orphan Asylum before being sent to Prince Edward Island by mistake  <sub>[v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
